description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Full Moon Poya - Holydays for the Year 2021
reasoning: This gazette content involves the declaration of Full Moon Poya Days for 2021 under the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971. This constitutes a regulatory matter where the Minister is exercising powers vested by existing legislation to make an official declaration. The content focuses on establishing legal/public holiday status for specific dates rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. It represents the implementation of statutory authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
